div.p: This code system http://fhirfli.dev/fhir/ig/cicada/CodeSystem/EvalStatus defines the following code:

tr.td: The dose was administered after the series was already complete. Every administered dose must be reported, so extraneous doses are tracked but do not affect the forecast.

description.value: Extension codes for dose evaluation status beyond the HL7 THO immunization-evaluation-dose-status CodeSystem. Only codes not covered by the standard are defined here.
